title: Asset manifest
description: Single source of truth for every file under assets/: what is wanted, what exists, where it came from, and under which license (ADR-004, wiki/systems/asset-pipeline.md). One row per asset; a row's path may name a file or a directory that it covers by prefix. tools/validate_data.py enforces that every file under assets/ (except dump/, source/, *.import, *.md, .gitkeep) is covered by exactly one wired row.

id.description: Unique across the manifest. Matches the data/ id where one exists (planet_lava, merchant_mk1).

path.description: File or directory under assets/. Required once wired; for earlier statuses it is the intended destination.

status.description: wanted (shopping list) -> generated (candidates in dump/gen/) -> approved (user picked one) -> wired (in assets/, referenced) -> replaced (kept for history).

provider.description: local: ComfyUI on the reference machine. gemini_app: the user, by hand, in the Gemini app (Google AI Pro). No pay-per-use API provider exists by design (ADR-004).

model.description: Checkpoint plus LoRA as named in tools/gen/models.json (e.g. 'sdxl-base-1.0 + gk_style_v1'), the Gemini app model name, or a tool version.

workflow.description: local rows: the ComfyUI workflow that produced the asset.

prompt.description: Full prompt including the style block, or the search that found an Envato item.

parent_id.description: derived rows: the manifest id this was cut or extracted from.

status.description: verified: terms read and recorded. pending: provider known, terms not yet confirmed. unknown: provenance itself is unknown.

terms.description: One line, e.g. 'SDXL OpenRAIL++-M, outputs unrestricted', 'Z-Image-Turbo Apache 2.0', or 'CC0'.

registered_project.description: Envato only: the project the download was registered to.
